messages:
Priya Patel: FYI escalated from support — Aureum Labs activation stuck. This is blocking their pilot cutover and their renewal (~30d). Marking as priority for CS handover.
Noah Chen: What specifically is failing?
Priya Patel: Ingest pipeline repeatedly returns 401 for their service account (token appears valid). Seeing rate-limited retries in logs + spike in client errors. Root thread: https://support.internal/ticket/SL-8421
Priya Patel: Quick log dump: ```2026-03-20T08:12:03Z ERROR auth: token validation failed for tenant=aur-labs svc=ingest reason=invalid_aud
2026-03-20T08:12:07Z WARN  retrying request id=xx-334 status=401 attempts=3
```
Samir Kaur: @Priya thanks. Are they on Self-Serve or Dedicated?
Priya Patel: Dedicated (reserved capacity). Customer says they completed onboarding checklist but cannot finish activation. Support tried rotating keys, clearing cached prefixes — no change.
Samir Kaur: This looks like config mismatch between their token audience and our token validator. If CS can loop in their infra contact we can confirm the aud claim.
Liam O'Neil: Renewal risk noted — I'll flag finance/renewal team. Do we have a comms plan if this drags >48h?
Priya Patel: We suggested customer temp fallback to hosted API to keep prod live; they rejected initially because of data isolation concerns. We need a coordinated plan: 1) immediate triage call within 6h, 2) set expectation email, 3) escalation path to Infra/SRE if kernel-level issue.
Noah Chen: I can run a validation against their token endpoint and confirm aud mapping. Will need the tenant ID and sample token. Priya can you paste sanitized token?
Priya Patel: Pasting sanitized sample: `eyJhbGciOiJ...SANITIZED...Xc9` (removed signature). Tenant: aur-772.
OpsBot: New ticket created: CS-Handoff-8421. Priority: P1. SLA target: 24h. Link: https://infra.internal/incidents/CS-8421
Samir Kaur: Proposed CS owner: Samir will lead customer-facing comms & coordinate engineering. Noah owns technical validation with support. Liam owns renewal comms internally. Priya continue to lead support troubleshooting.
Samir Kaur: Draft message to customer (suggested): "Hi Maria — thanks for your patience. We're scheduling a joint call today to resolve the activation blocker. We'll validate token config and, if needed, provide a temporary secure fallback so your pilot can continue while we fix the root cause. Expect an invite within 2 hours. — Samir, Redwood CS"
Liam O'Neil: Add to that: "We recognize your renewal window is coming up. Our team is prioritizing a fix and we'll provide a written mitigation plan within 24 hours."
Priya Patel: Customer contact is Maria Alvarez (maria@aureum.ai). She said timezone PST afternoons work. I'll ping them and share the invite once scheduled.
Noah Chen: I'll start token checks now, will post results here in 30m. If aud mismatch, quick fix usually on their side (change client registration) — but help from their infra will speed it.
Samir Kaur: Can someone from Solutions Eng join the call? @Liam can you pull Jon or Priya from SE?
Liam O'Neil: Looping in Jon now (separately).
Priya Patel: Update: Maria confirmed call at 16:00 PST. She accepted fallback options if we can guarantee isolation for the data.
Noah Chen: Quick update — validated token aud != expected (ours: rwinf-api, theirs: rwinf-ingest). Sending exact mismatch to Maria and asking for a reissue or allowlist of aud alias.
Samir Kaur: OK. Plan A: customer reissues token (fast). Plan B: we implement aud aliasing for this tenant as temporary patch (requires infra change). If Plan A stalls >6h, trigger Plan B.
Liam O'Neil: I'll escalate to renewal lead with current plan and timeline.
Priya Patel: I'll capture the customer's feedback about the onboarding docs — they called the token setup instructions unclear. Samir, can you own a quick follow-up doc for them post-call?
Samir Kaur: Yep, I'll draft a short step-by-step and a checklist for future tenants.
OpsBot: Reminder set: follow-up in 24h for status update.
Noah Chen: Technical note (for infra): If we enable aud aliasing, verify KV cache invalidation on Dedicated pools. Posted ticket to infra: https://infra.internal/reqs/AA-993
Priya Patel: Thanks team. After the call I'll post meeting notes and the customer's sentiment (they said they're nervous about the renewal timing).
Samir Kaur: Good. If we resolve within 24h we close as P1 handoff completed and update renewal. If not, we'll prepare exec summary for AM to use in renewal conversations.
Liam O'Neil: Agreed. Assigning owners in our CRM now.
Priya Patel: Closing loop for now — will add minutes and next steps post-call. :white_check_mark:
